The LAP Ubertas tilt LED downlight is a versatile lighting solution for indoor installations. This integrated LED downlight features a stylish polished chrome twist-lock bezel and offers easy wire connection for quick fitting. It is dimmable and provides adjustable colour temperature, allowing selection between 2700K warm white, 4000K cool white, or 6000K daylight to suit various environments. Ideal for domestic projects such as living rooms, hallways, or bedrooms, its tilt function allows for directional light. With a 4W power consumption and 420 lumens output, it delivers efficient illumination and has a long 30,000-hour lifespan.
b: Tiltable Design Directs Light Precisely Where Needed
